title: I built my own GTA 6 (but it's 2d pixelart and 100% AI)
author: SneakerHunterDev
selftext:
Working on a fully AI native online game similar to gta online but in habbo hotel style and all content is live AI generated!  
Players can create own characters, weapons, buildings in the shared universe and raid others players homes!

About the tech:  
\- I use different AI apis like OpenAI, groq, gemini to generate sprites  
\- for development I use cursor + Unity + claude code (and sometimes codex)

If you are interested, you can join the discord to try the first demo: [https://discord.gg/BFqQZHhkv6](https://discord.gg/BFqQZHhkv6)
